mechanism_narrative: Strong housing starts (HOUST > 1600) indicate robust consumer demand, driving higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1600 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in industrial production (INDPRO > 100) and housing starts (HOUST > 1600) indicate strong economic expansion, driving positive equity returns through elevated corporate earnings and investor confidence over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO > 100 and HOUST > 1600) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor markets generate wage pressures and inflation, triggering central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 270) signals central bank tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 270 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 99.5) indicates weakening economic activity, reducing corporate earnings expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 99.5 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong retail sales (RSAFS > 620000) and low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2) indicate accommodative monetary policy and robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: strong consumer spending with low rates
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS > 620000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), recessionary conditions prompt central bank rate cuts and fiscal stimulus, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0 over a 3-year rolling window.
